payload.summary: Remove the remaining PR 3538 leftovers after 13 Nov 2026 (split from #08216B, which closed only the calculator fixes)
payload.detail: #08216B was archived on 17 Oct with an outcome covering only the clinical-math calculators. Still open: src/app/api/proxy/route.ts (nothing calls it), scripts/recalculate-answer-support-labels.ts and its test (run by nothing), and the developer tool pages under src/app/mockups/development (unreachable duplicates of /admin/developer-hub) - remove after the 30-day dead-code window (13 Nov 2026) via npm run check:dead-code-candidate. The safe-number editor, attendance roster, QR check-in helper and clinical note editor are unwired: wire or remove each; the note editor needs a privacy review before any use. The 16 Oct clinical-math calculator changes (IBW guidance, lithium boundaries, dose rounding) need clinician verification before any clinical use.
